'''Falk''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who grew up on the streets of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Doda Bodonawieedo/Legends|Doda Bodonawieedo]] as a companion. A daring and mischievous lad whose troublesome activities only became more dangerous and criminal as he grew older, Falk would in [[Time/Legends|time]] form the [[Shawpee Gang]], which began as small-time [[Gangster/Legends|hoodlums]] committing minor crimes before the gang's criminal activities advanced as they grew older.

By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], both Falk and Bodonawieedo left the Shawpees to join Tatooine [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|gang]], with Falk becoming a runner for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] henchman [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]]. However, Falk's service would ultimately end with his life when he was caught eavesdropping on a conversation between Jabba and Fortuna and was summarily [[Death/Legends|executed]] as a result.

==Biography==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Falk grew up in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[City/Legends|city]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. In his youth, Falk was the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Doda Bodonawieedo/Legends|Doda Bodonawieedo's]] primary playing companion.<ref name="SWTSE" /> With Falk and Bodonawieedo being inseparable,<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|75|MAX 7-10|Max Rebo Band}}</ref> the former would bring the latter into plots to [[Thief/Legends|steal]] [[ronto barbecue steak]]s from street [[Merchant/Legends|vendors]] and to engage in the act of [[frocking]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]].<ref name="SWTSE" />

[[File:Doda.jpg|thumb|left|210px|Doda Bodonawieedo, with whom Falk was inseparable and they were friends starting from childhood]]
In [[Time/Legends|time]], Falk's stunts grew more dangerous and criminal. By the time he and Bodonawieedo reached adolescence, Falk had gathered other youths and formed the [[Shawpee Gang]].<ref name="SWTSE" /> Comprised of small-time [[Gangster/Legends|hoodlums]] who prowled Mos Eisley's streets,<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|145|Shawpee Gang}}</ref> the Shawpees were initially content with break-ins, muggings, and fighting with rival gangs, before growing older, and forming ties with Mos Eisley's criminal underworld. The gang further moved into protection rackets, running numbers and [[Spice/Legends|spice]], and [[Dealmaker|fencing]] operations. Bodonawieedo got by through his friendship with Falk and talents as a [[Musician/Legends|minstrel]] while remaining relatively free of criminal activity.<ref name="SWTSE" />

By [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Falk and Bodonawieedo left the Shawpees to join [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Jabba's criminal empire/Legends|gang]], which was also based on Tatooine. Having first drifted into one of Jabba's satellite operations, the pair in time went to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] to seek their fortunes there.<ref name="SWTSE" /> Bodonawieedo found his [[Music/Legends|music]] was popular with Jabba's [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|guards]],<ref name="FF" /> while Falk had a promising start as a runner for the Hutt's henchman [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]]. However, when Falk eavesdropped on a conversation between the Hutt and Fortuna, he was caught and summarily [[Death/Legends|executed]]. Bodonawieedo, who was not present at the time, was spared after another Rodian, [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], spoke out on his behalf.<ref name="SWTSE" /> At some point, the Shawpee Gang, which Falk had left to join Jabba's organization, had itself fallen in with the Hutt's empire, prior to Jabba being killed in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY's]] [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]].<ref name="FF" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Bib_TPM.png|thumb|right|250px|Falk's inquisitive nature led to his death after he was caught eavesdropping on a conversation between Jabba the Hutt and Bib Fortuna (both pictured).]]
Falk was a daring and mischievous lad whose troublesome activities became more dangerous and criminal as he grew older.<ref name="SWTSE" /> Having gathered other hoodlums,<ref name="TCSWE" /> Falk formed the Shawpee Gang, which would grow more criminal as time progressed. After leaving the Shawpee Gang and attempting to seek his fortune with Jabba's organization, his inquisitive nature would lead to his death after he was caught eavesdropping on Jabba and Fortuna's conversation.<ref name="SWTSE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Falk was created for [[1997]]'s ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="SWTSE" />
